h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Firozabad

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Firozabad

c: Firozabad's glass and bangle units run hot furnaces through the day, and the people who work in them spend long hours standing. Business owners here sometimes ask us about a small outdoor gym for workers, and housing colonies and schools ask for one for residents and students. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment for all of these sites, made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,030 km from Firozabad.

We deliver by road and install through our own team or a dealer in north India, using grouting or a self-standing base to suit the ground. A factory compound may only have a paved corner near the gate, while a colony park has open soil. Both can take an outdoor gym if the machines are spaced correctly. Send us photos and dimensions, and we will mark each station and its clear space on a layout drawing.

items.q: Can we install outdoor gym equipment on a paved factory compound?
items.a: Yes. On firm paving we can use a self-standing base, and on open soil we grout the machine. Send us photos of the surface and we will suggest the right method.

items.q: Which machines suit workers who stand all day?
items.a: Seated machines such as the Fun Cycle and seated twisters, plus shoulder wheels for stretching. Add a leg press for strength. Users should start gently and increase slowly.
Three years on galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts, one year on springs, bearings and spare parts. It covers manufacturing defects when installed and maintained as per our instructions.
